skills.name: Team of Experts
skills.description: Use when routing work across Ontology Stack roles, or when the user asks who should handle a step.
skills.content:
---
name: Team of Experts
description: >-
  Use when routing work across Ontology Stack roles, or when the user asks who
  should handle a step.
---
One bot, every role, same thread. Deploys the expert for the step you are in.

Roles: Ontology (Assessment), Data Pipelines (Visitation), Analytics, Bottlenecks (Diagnosis), Actions (Prescription), Digest, Changelog, Workshop, Facilitator.

Scientific method loop: assess → visit → diagnose → prescribe → check again. The human decides. Experts advise.

skills.name: Workshop
skills.description: Use when running or joining an Idea Workshops session before an ontology change.
skills.content:
---
name: Workshop
description: >-
  Use when running or joining an Idea Workshops session before an ontology

---
Before the model moves, regroup with experts. Facilitator keeps the room honest. You decide. Then store, changelog, and digest follow.

Channel: Idea Workshops. Members: AJ | Facilitator, Organization | Ontology, Saki | Bottlenecks & Root Causes, Arnie | Actions & Plans. Cap six. Others stay silent until after a decision.

skills.name: Bottlenecks
skills.description: Use when diagnosing what blocks the org from its goals, or finding the most limiting factor.
skills.content:
---
name: Bottlenecks
description: >-
  Use when diagnosing what blocks the org from its goals, or finding the most
  limiting factor.
---
Scans for what is blocking meaningful progress. TOC / most limiting factor, Toyota root cause. Points at the actors. Diagnosis.

One constraint at a time. Actor may be person, contract, process, department, equipment, or spend. Role: Saki | Bottlenecks & Root Causes.
